component: Tree header ARIA sort and localization

quotes.text: "no other header buttons should have sorting classes"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The header cell receives l10n.a11y and aria-sort, while its child button keeps l10n.header. Generic/thread sorting removes the previous attribute and sets the current header; AutoTreeView uses the view's accepted sort values. Address Book retains button sorting classes as well. CSS reads aria-sort on the header to draw the non-picker button's arrow. The migration copies existing label patterns into separate header aria-label strings. Tests directly check the split Fluent IDs and aria-sort cells, but added/retargeted assertions omit messages and one retained message still describes the old button classes. Keep that test-description gap and the tentative ariaLabel name proposal separate from actual adopted source.
title: Tree header cells own sort state and a separate localized accessible label
